common.responseTime: Response time: We aim to respond within 5 business days

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.subtitle: We are committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people of all abilities.

commitment.title: Our Commitment
commitment.content: Oikion is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. We are continually improving the user experience for everyone and applying the relevant accessibility standards.

conformance.title: Conformance Status
conformance.intro: The Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) defines requirements for designers and developers to improve accessibility for people with disabilities. We aim to conform to WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards.
conformance.workingTowards: We are currently working towards achieving full WCAG 2.1 Level AA conformance. As we continue to develop and enhance our platform, accessibility remains a core consideration in our design and development processes.

features.title: Accessibility Features
features.intro: Our platform includes the following accessibility features:

navigation.title: Navigation & Structure
items: Consistent navigation throughout the site
Skip navigation links to bypass repetitive content
Logical heading structure for screen readers
Keyboard navigation support for all interactive elements
Focus indicators visible when navigating with keyboard

visual.title: Visual Design
items: Color contrast ratios meeting WCAG AA standards
Text resizing support without loss of functionality
Dark mode support for reduced eye strain
No content that flashes more than three times per second
Alternative text for meaningful images

forms.title: Forms & Interactions
items: Clearly labeled form fields
Error messages associated with relevant form inputs
Success and error states clearly communicated
Sufficient time to complete tasks
No automatic time-outs without warning

screenReader.title: Screen Reader Support
items: ARIA labels and landmarks for improved navigation
Dynamic content updates announced to screen readers
Tables with proper headers and relationships
Links and buttons with descriptive text

technologies.title: Technologies Used
technologies.intro: Accessibility of Oikion relies on the following technologies:
items: HTML5
CSS3
JavaScript
WAI-ARIA (Web Accessibility Initiative - Accessible Rich Internet Applications)
technologies.conclusion: These technologies are relied upon for conformance with the accessibility standards used.

compatibility.title: Compatibility
compatibility.intro: Oikion is designed to be compatible with:
items: Latest versions of major browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
Screen readers including JAWS, NVDA, and VoiceOver
Voice recognition software
Screen magnification software
Mobile assistive technologies

knownLimitations.title: Known Limitations
knownLimitations.intro: Despite our best efforts, some content may have limitations:
items: Some third-party content or integrations may not be fully accessible
PDF documents uploaded by users may not be accessible
Some complex data visualizations may have limited alternative text
Legacy content may not meet current standards
knownLimitations.conclusion: We are actively working to address these limitations and improve accessibility across all areas of our platform.

assessment.title: Assessment Methods
items: Automated testing tools
Manual testing with assistive technologies
User feedback and testing
Periodic third-party audits

feedback.title: Feedback & Contact
feedback.intro: We welcome your feedback on the accessibility of Oikion. If you encounter any accessibility barriers or have suggestions for improvement, please contact us:
feedback.reportingIntro: When reporting accessibility issues, please include:
reportingItems: The page URL where you encountered the issue
A description of the accessibility problem
The assistive technology and browser you were using

continuousImprovement.title: Continuous Improvement
continuousImprovement.content: Accessibility is an ongoing effort at Oikion. We regularly review and update our accessibility practices to ensure we meet or exceed standards and provide an inclusive experience for all users. This statement will be updated as we make improvements and changes to our platform.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.subtitle: This policy explains how we use cookies and similar technologies.

whatAreCookies.title: What Are Cookies
whatAreCookies.content: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device when you visit our website. They help us provide you with a better experience by remembering your preferences and understanding how you use our platform.

howWeUse.title: How We Use Cookies
howWeUse.intro: We use cookies for various purposes:

essential.title: Essential Cookies
essential.intro: Required for the platform to function properly. These cannot be disabled:
items: Clerk authentication (__session, __client_uat) — keep you logged in
Cloudflare (_cfuvid) — infrastructure security via Clerk
App access gate (oik_access) — when enabled, proves you entered the access code

functional.title: Functional Cookies
functional.intro: Enhance your experience by remembering your preferences:
items: NEXT_LOCALE — language preference (Greek/English)
sidebar_state — expanded or collapsed sidebar state
react-resizable-panels:layout and :collapsed — email layout preferences

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies
analytics.intro: Help us understand how you use our platform. Used only when analytics is enabled:
items: PostHog (ph_posthog) — usage statistics, feature flags, product analytics

marketing.title: Marketing Cookies
marketing.intro: Used only when you configure certain integrations:
items: Facebook cookies — when setting up WhatsApp integration in Messages

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Cookies
thirdParty.intro: Our platform uses third-party services that may set their own cookies:

inventory.title: Cookie Inventory
inventory.intro: Complete list of cookies we use, when they are set, and at which stage of your visit:

browserSettings.title: Browser Settings
browserSettings.intro: You can control cookies through your browser settings:
items: Block all cookies (may affect website functionality)
Delete existing cookies
Set preferences for specific websites
Receive notifications when cookies are set

impact.title: Impact of Disabling Cookies
impact.intro: Disabling certain cookies may affect your experience:
items: You may need to log in more frequently
Your preferences may not be saved
Some features may not work correctly
You may see less relevant content

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.intro: For questions about our cookie policy, please contact us:

gdpr.title: GDPR Compliance
gdpr.subtitle: We are committed to protecting your personal data in accordance with GDPR.

commitment.title: Our Commitment to GDPR
commitment.content: As a company operating in the European Union, Oikion is committed to complying with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). This page outlines how we protect your personal data and your rights under GDPR.

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.intro: We process your personal data based on the following legal grounds:

items.label: Contract:
items.detail: To provide our real estate platform services

items.label: Legitimate Interest:
items.detail: To improve our services and prevent fraud

items.label: Consent:
items.detail: For marketing communications and optional features

items.label: Legal Obligation:
items.detail: To comply with applicable laws and regulations

rights.title: Your Rights Under GDPR
rights.intro: Under GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:

access.title: Right of Access
access.content: You have the right to know what personal data we hold about you and to request a copy of that data.

rectification.title: Right to Rectification
rectification.content: You have the right to correct any inaccurate or incomplete personal data we hold about you.

erasure.title: Right to Erasure
erasure.content: You have the right to request deletion of your personal data in certain circumstances.

restrictProcessing.title: Right to Restrict Processing
restrictProcessing.content: You have the right to request that we restrict how we use your personal data in certain situations.

portability.title: Right to Data Portability
portability.content: You have the right to receive your personal data in a structured, commonly used format and transfer it to another service provider.

object.title: Right to Object
object.content: You have the right to object to the processing of your personal data in certain circumstances.

withdrawConsent.title: Right to Withdraw Consent
withdrawConsent.content: Where processing is based on consent, you have the right to withdraw your consent at any time.

exerciseRights.title: How to Exercise Your Rights
exerciseRights.intro: To exercise any of your rights under GDPR, you can:
items: Use the data protection tools in your account settings
Submit a request through our support system

dataSecurity.title: Data Security Measures
dataSecurity.intro: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data:
items: Encryption of data in transit and at rest
Regular security audits and assessments
Access controls and authentication
Staff training on data protection
Incident response procedures

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.intro: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary:

items.label: Account data:
items.detail: As long as your account is active plus 3 years

items.label: Transaction data:
items.detail: 7 years for tax and regulatory purposes

items.label: Marketing data:
items.detail: Until you opt out or 2 years of inactivity

items.label: Analytics data:
items.detail: Aggregated data retained for up to 5 years

dataBreach.title: Data Breach Notification
dataBreach.intro: In case of a data breach that risks your rights and freedoms, we will:
items: Notify the relevant supervisory authority within 72 hours
Inform affected individuals without undue delay
Provide clear information about the breach and our response
Take immediate steps to contain and remediate the breach

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.intro: For all data protection questions and to exercise your rights under GDPR:

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before using our services.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing or using the Oikion platform, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our services.

description.title: Description of Service
description.intro: Oikion provides a comprehensive real estate management platform that includes:
items: Property management and listing tools
Client relationship management (CRM) system
Analytics and reporting capabilities
Document management and storage
Integration with MLS and other real estate services
Mobile applications and web access

eligibility.title: User Eligibility
items: Be at least 18 years of age
Be a licensed real estate professional (where applicable)
Provide accurate and complete information
Comply with all applicable laws and regulations
Not be prohibited from using our services under applicable law

responsibilities.title: User Responsibilities
responsibilities.intro: As a user of Oikion, you agree to:
items: Maintain accurate and up-to-date account information
Keep your login credentials secure and confidential
Use the platform only for lawful business purposes
Comply with all applicable real estate laws and regulations
Respect intellectual property rights of others
Not attempt to gain unauthorized access to our systems
Report any security vulnerabilities or breaches

prohibited.title: Prohibited Uses
prohibited.intro: You may not use Oikion to:
items: Violate laws, regulations, or third-party rights
Transmit harmful, offensive, or inappropriate content
Interfere with or disrupt our services or servers
Attempt to reverse-engineer or copy our software
Use automated systems to access our platform without permission
Impersonate others or provide false information
Engage in fraudulent or deceptive practices

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.content: You retain ownership of the content you upload. Oikion and its licensors own all intellectual property rights in the platform. You are responsible for data accuracy and compliance.

subscription.title: Subscription and Billing
subscription.content: We offer various subscription plans with different pricing. Charges are billed in advance and generally non-refundable. You must maintain valid payment information.

termination.title: Termination
termination.content: Either party may terminate these Terms. Upon termination, access ceases and data retention follows the guidelines in our Privacy Policy.

disclaimers.title: Disclaimers and Limitations
disclaimers.content: We strive to provide reliable service but cannot guarantee 100% uptime. While we make reasonable efforts to ensure data accuracy, we cannot guarantee the accuracy of MLS data, market information, or other third-party data. To the maximum extent permitted by law, Oikion will not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your use of our platform.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.intro: For questions about these terms, please contact us:

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.subtitle: Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: At Oikion, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our real estate management platform and services.

personal.title: Personal Information
personal.intro: We collect information that you provide directly to us, including:
items: Name, email address, and contact information
Professional license numbers and certifications
Business information and brokerage details
Payment and billing information
Property listings and client data you enter into our system

automatic.title: Automatically Collected Information
automatic.intro: We automatically collect certain information when you use our services:
items: Device information and IP addresses
Usage patterns and feature interactions
Browser type and operating system
Log files and performance metrics

howWeUse.title: How We Use Your Information
howWeUse.intro: We use the collected information to:
items: Provide and maintain our real estate management services
Process transactions and manage your account
Communicate with you about updates and support
Improve our platform and develop new features
Comply with legal obligations and prevent fraud
Send marketing communications (with your consent)

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.intro: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information:
items: Encryption of data in transit and at rest
Regular security audits and penetration testing
Access controls and authentication mechanisms
Secure data centers with physical and digital protections
Employee training on data protection practices

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.intro: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights:
items: Access your personal information
Correct inaccurate information
Delete your personal information
Restrict processing activities
Data portability
Object to certain processing activities
Withdraw consent

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.intro: For questions about this privacy policy, please contact us:
